text_simplified: A wise mother trains her daughter in managing household affairs, for today's girl is tomorrow's mother, just as Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her) served in the home of Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him). Whenever the journey of upbringing feels long, parents should remember the immense reward prepared by Allah; Shaykh Abd al-Aziz ibn Baz (may Allah have mercy on him) explained that both father and mother share in the reward promised in the statement of the Prophet ﷺ: "Whoever is tested with anything regarding daughters and treats them kindly, they will be a shield for him from the Fire" (Sahih Muslim 2629).

The Arabic says 'the immense reward' without 'prepared by Allah'; the English adds a phrase not present in the source.
